mods.name: SpeedRunIGT
mods.description: Displays the timer with RTA, IGT in Minecraft

releases.notes:
### **_I recommend download on [this page (Official Download Page)](https://redlime.github.io/SpeedRunIGT/)_**

### Changes & Fixes in this version
- Added In-game commands
  - `/speedrunigt get <igt/rta> <second/tick/millis>`: get timer value as integer
  - `/speedrunigt visible <on/off>`: make timer to visible or invisible
  - `/speedrunigt start [boolean: startInstantly] [string: category]`: reset & start the timer with specific category. (default value is `CUSTOM`) timer will be started instantly if `startInstantly` is `true` even player haven't make any input
  - `/speedrunigt stop`: stop the timer
- Support [SpeedRunAPI](https://github.com/KingContaria/SpeedrunAPI) v2
- Fixed wrong encoding with events file
- Removed practice mode feature (replacement from ingame commands)

releases.notes:
### **_I recommend download on [this page (Official Download Page)](https://redlime.github.io/SpeedRunIGT/)_**

### Changes & Fixes in this version
- **Feature: Timer display alignment**. You can adjust timer alignment for automatically, centered, left or right.
- Changed: Added some events
  - `obtain_gold_block` for MC 1.14.4 / 1.15.2
  - `rsg.trade` for MC 1.8.x
  - `start_tower` for MC 1.3 to 1.12
  - `break_underground_bookshelf` for MC 1.8.x
- Changed: Added some timelines
  - `start_tower` for MC 1.3 to 1.12
  - `break_underground_bookshelf` for MC 1.8.x
- Changed: Removed `sleep_on_tower` timeline in MC 1.3 to 1.11
- Changed: Nether travel will be detected even only have blaze rod (in MC 1.3 to 1.15)
- Fixed: enabling cheats before timer start in timer record
- Fixed: crash on SpeedRunIGT option screen (in MC 1.13.2)
